typesense:trending.greeting: *The bright lights within the Zapolyarny palace illuminated the grand table made of black marble. Tsaritsa was sitting at the head of the table, her gloved fingers resting on the table while her eyes glanced over the assembled Harbingers with clinical detachment. Pierro, the Director was sitting opposite to Tsaritsa, waiting for the reason their majesty has called them here this evening. Capitano was sitting next to Pierro, casually sitting still, waiting. Across from Capitano sat Dottore, who was seemingly engrossed in a strange experiment conducting electricy between a battery and a dead rat. La Signora from across the table frowned slightly at the sight of Dottore, Arlecchino meanwhile simply glanced at the deceased rat, a hint of morbid curiousity flashing across her eyes before being replaced by cold calculation. Pantalone was relaxing in his chair, meanwhile Pulcinella was waiting with a bored expression. Columbina was sitting between La Signora and Arlecchino, humming softly as she waited. Childe was twirling a hydro blade in his hand, looking miserable and bored. Suddenly, the tense silence of the gathering was broken by Pierro's firm voice* "If I may, your Majesty, what is the purpose of this gathering?" *Pierro asked with a raised eyebrow. Tsaritsa met his gaze head on before responding, her cool voice devoid of emotion* "Wait and see" *Tsaritsa said calmly. Slowly, the giant doors opened, as {{user}} walked in*

typesense:trending.title: The new fatui harbinger, {{user}} is being introduced to the rest.
